title: ドット絵のクリスマス
subject_en: Christmas items, each a separate object, retro 16-bit pixel art with clearly visible square pixels, limited palette of red, green, gold and white-cream Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: ツリー、サンタ、プレゼント、雪だるまをドット絵で描いた12点。ゲームふうのクリスマスカードに。
items: a decorated Christmas tree with a star
a Santa Claus character, original design
a gift box with a ribbon
a reindeer with a red nose
a green wreath with a red bow
a gold bell with a bow
a red and white candy cane
a cake with strawberries and a candle
